validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table page read by eye from 200-dpi crops of each spread, dense pages re-cropped and zoomed; tesseract used only as a cross-check. Each section was diffed row by row against 8-3180 (same ref and part number, then same part number at another ref). Numerical index (printed pp44-47) read in full by eye from 200-dpi crops and typed out independently, then compared with the transcription in both directions (part number, printed page, ref); every mismatch re-checked at full zoom on both the index and the table.
validation.refContinuity: Continuous except printed gaps (steering ref 14 is filled by a row added from the numerical index and the user): steering ref 27; transaxle refs 16, 19, 24, 63 and 72-74. Repeated refs kept as printed: steering 34 and 35, electrical 9, flywheel_crankshaft 18, 21 and 22, cylinder_block 36. Ref 0 (unnumbered): carburetor and starter header rows, three steering sub-rows under ref 31. Transaxle 53A follows 53. Paint and oil tables each restart at ref 1.
validation.quantities: Every row carries a qty except motion_drive_clutch 27 (TIRE, **). UAR on chassis_hood 25, steering 36, electrical 38, flywheel_crankshaft 16, engine_base_oil_filter 14, ignition_charging 11 and 12, governor 20, engine_air_baffles_breather 2 and 4, exhaust_system 2, 5 and 9. Fractional qty 77.5 kept as printed (fender_seat 16 trim strip).
validation.numericalIndex: Full by-eye pass: all 731 entries of the printed numerical index (pp44-47) read by eye and typed out independently, then compared with the transcription in both directions (part number, printed page, ref); every mismatch re-checked at full zoom on both the index and the table (paint and oil on the cover page are not in the index). All entries match except the items below, all decided by the user 2026-11-17. Index value used (partNo differs from partNoAsPrinted, original in the row flags): fender_seat 7/9 (table C34803, now C34808), fender_seat 7/18 (table C35119, now C35386), prepainted_deck 21/4 (table 113-176, now 131-176), flywheel_crankshaft 31/2 (table C40888, a repeat of ref 1, now C34618) and 31/4 (table C40889, a repeat of ref 3, now C34651). Table value kept (index differs, flagged): chassis_hood 5/19 C31365 (index C31395) and 5/20 C31597 (index C31397), governor 39/27 C40890 (index C40980), flywheel_crankshaft 31/21 .020" piston C34587 (the index prints C34586 twice and has no C34587). Steering ref 14: the table prints no ref 14 row but the index lists C35396 at 11/14; the user said it is a flat washer, qty 1, so a row was added (description and qty from the user, flagged). Table row with no index entry: motion_drive_shift 9 C35264. NSS rows have no part number and are not indexed.
validation.partNoForms: Briggs 'BR' numbers stored bare (221535), Case letter prefixes closed up (C42812), hardware codes as NNN-NNNN, NSS/'*'/'**' part cells stored as NSS (the '*'/'**' footnotes kept in the row flags); footnote marker on C42812* removed from partNo and kept in partNoAsPrinted.
